key_terms.حٰمٓ: Disjointed letters Ha Mim, appearing at the start of Surah Ash-Shura and others, often interpreted as divine oaths or references to the Imams.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the disjointed letters Ha Mim in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, the disjointed letters 'Ha Mim' are viewed not merely as divine mysteries but as sacred abbreviations often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt or specific divine attributes, establishing an immediate spiritual authority. This opening serves as a rhetorical device to capture the listener's attention before revealing the chapter's core message regarding the consequences of divine decree and the fate of the righteous versus the arrogant.
